kind: instrument validity check, registered BEFORE it is run

the_question.statement: There are two kinds of negative, and they require completely different text in the record.

negative_A_about_the_models.condition: J departs substantially from the identity, yet the J-lens readout is still approximately equal to the logit lens readout
negative_A_about_the_models.meaning: the Jacobian genuinely carries no readable information beyond the unembedding in these models
negative_A_about_the_models.status: a substantive finding about the models

negative_B_about_us.condition: J is approximately the identity, so the J-lens degenerates into a plain logit lens by construction
negative_B_about_us.meaning: our J construction is degenerate, this negative does not adjudicate the construct, and EQ2 amounts to having FAILED TO ADJUDICATE
negative_B_about_us.status: a finding about our implementation, not about the models

the_question.why_it_must_be_settled: the depth model's ratio of 0.986 - the J-lens performing slightly WORSE than the plain logit lens - makes B a live possibility that must be excluded before A may be written

what_will_be_measured.per_layer_degeneracy: for square J_l, the relative Frobenius distance from the identity, ||J_l - I||_F / ||I||_F
what_will_be_measured.spectrum: singular value distribution of each J_l, plus eigenvalue statistics where meaningful
what_will_be_measured.identity_attributable_share: the proportion of the J-lens readout attributable to the identity component, obtained by decomposing J_l into a scaled-identity part and a residual and comparing their contributions
what_will_be_measured.shape_contingency: if J_l is not square, the deviation from the scaled-identity or projection component is reported instead

connection_to_OD_016.od_016_registered: a comparability tolerance whose Tukey lower fence came out NEGATIVE and therefore non-binding below
connection_to_OD_016.what_od_016_was_explicitly_written_to_ca: a lens whose Jacobian has degenerated toward the identity, which is to say a J-lens that has collapsed into an ordinary logit lens
connection_to_OD_016.the_situation_now: the present symptom is EXACTLY the failure mode OD-016 was supposed to catch, and OD-016's primary rule could not have caught it
connection_to_OD_016.d1_must_report: whether OD-016 WOULD have fired on this data had its lower fence been effective

pre_registered_constraints_verbatim: No result of D-1 may reopen R-2.
No result of D-1 may cause the target to be touched.
No result of D-1 may revise any criterion.
D-1 decides ONLY whether the record says negative-A or negative-B.
If the conclusion is negative-B, the correct successor is A NEW STUDY REQUIRING ITS OWN INDEPENDENT PRE-REGISTRATION, not a continuation of EQ2, and it is outside the present authorisation.
asymmetric_motivation_labelled_verbatim: The motivation for proposing D-1 is asymmetric: had the J-lens readout been several times the logit lens readout, this diagnostic would not have been requested. It is therefore labelled an instrument-validity check triggered only under a negative result. Its legitimacy rests on the fact that OUTCOME AND STAY-OR-GO DECISION HAVE BEEN DECOUPLED IN ADVANCE: the terminal ruling was made before D-1 and cannot be overturned by it, so D-1 cannot be used to select a favourable stay-or-go conclusion and can only determine the CATEGORY of the negative.

permitted: the external lenses already acquired and byte-verified in R-0, namely the positive control, depth test and negative control lenses from neuronpedia/jacobian-lens
the profiles already computed in R-1 and R-1b
what_d1_may_read.note: D-1 needs only the external lenses, so it can be completed without approaching the forbidden set at all

abort_rule: if D-1 turns out to require reading lens_A or lens_B, or touching the target, D-1 is ABANDONED and the study closes as 'negative, category undetermined'

decision_rule_frozen_before_the_measurem.note: fixed now so the category is not chosen after seeing the numbers
decision_rule_frozen_before_the_measurem.negative_B_if: the relative Frobenius distance ||J_l - I||_F / ||I||_F is small across most layers, indicating J is close to the identity
decision_rule_frozen_before_the_measurem.negative_A_if: that distance is large across layers, so J is far from the identity and yet adds nothing readable

the_threshold.meaning: a relative distance below 0.5 would mean J is closer to the identity than to a matrix unrelated to it
the_threshold.reference_point: for a random matrix of matched norm the expected relative distance is approximately sqrt(2) = 1.414, since ||J - I||^2 = ||J||^2 + ||I||^2 for uncorrelated J and I of equal norm
the_threshold.rule: median over layers below 0.5 supports negative-B; at or above 1.0 supports negative-A; between 0.5 and 1.0 is reported as INTERMEDIATE and the category is recorded as mixed rather than forced

claim_ceiling: An instrument-validity diagnostic. It licenses no claim of any kind, and it cannot alter the terminal ruling.
